title: 군검찰단의 조직에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Heads of Military Prosecutors' Offices of Each Armed Service)
(1) Each Military Prosecutors' Office shall have a head (hereinafter referred to in this Article as the "Head of a Military Prosecutors' Office of an armed service"), who shall be appointed from among field-grade officers or higher who are military legal officers.
(2) The Head of a Military Prosecutors' Office of an armed service shall, under the orders of the Chief of Staff of the relevant armed service, exercise overall control over affairs under the Office's jurisdiction and direct and supervise military prosecutors assigned thereto.
(3) Where the position of Head of a Military Prosecutors' Office of an armed service is vacant or the Head is unable to perform his or her duties due to unavoidable circumstances, the senior division head and then the senior military prosecutor shall act on behalf of the Head, in that order.
